title: Tenant User JWT Local Connector proxy boundary regression

phases.objective: Prove that a valid tenant User JWT reaches tenant-scoped Local Connector device resolution on tenant-safe proxy routes without requiring an admin backend key, while explicit admin/break-glass routes remain denied before device or credential access.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: POST /connector/:device_id/browser with a valid User JWT
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The request passes mixed authentication, reaches exact user-and-tenant device resolution, cannot override tenant scope from request input, and never requires admin_backend_api_key_required; an explicit browser4 break-glass request remains 403 before DB or connector access.
steps: Create the production mixed authentication middleware with a configured backend key and User JWT verifier secret.
Sign a bounded User JWT carrying one user_id and tenant_id.
Mount the production Connector Proxy router with the production mixed authentication middleware.
Use a process-local fake MySQL pool so the journey performs no live database connection or mutation.
Call the tenant-safe /connector/:device_id/browser route with the User JWT and a conflicting tenant_id in the request body.
Verify the route reaches local_connector_user_configs resolution using the authenticated user_id and tenant_id, never the conflicting body tenant_id.
Return the normal device_not_found result from the empty fake registry rather than an admin backend-key denial.
Call the explicit /connector/:device_id/browser4 admin/break-glass route with the same User JWT.
Verify browser4 fails with admin_backend_api_key_required before any additional DB query, credential lookup, or connector forwarding.
assertions: createBackendApiKeyMiddleware accepts a valid User JWT as a non-admin user principal even when BACKEND_API_KEY is configured.
The tenant-safe browser proxy does not return admin_backend_api_key_required for a valid User JWT.
Device resolution binds exact authenticated user_id and tenant_id parameters.
A request-body tenant_id cannot override req.auth.tenant_id.
The empty tenant-scoped fake device registry returns device_not_found without any external connector call.
browser4 remains admin-only and returns admin_backend_api_key_required for the same tenant User JWT.
The admin-only denial happens before any additional database, credential, or connector access.
No live DB connection, provider call, local-device action, secret read, SQL mutation, or Production action occurs in the test.
